summary: On July 31, 2026, Bit Origin Ltd furnished a Form 6-K with a press release outlining strategic priorities for fiscal 2027 and a proposed corporate rebranding to SANGRIX INC. The name change, reflecting a focus on AI computing infrastructure, is subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on August 11, 2026, and effectiveness requires Cayman Islands registration. The company also reiterates its commitment to a recently announced transaction for sixteen NVIDIA Blackwell B300 AI servers, expected delivery in Q3 2026, deployment in Malaysia, and future selective expansion. No deal terms, prices, or advisors are disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and server deployment milestones.
